recognize_zh: 同一腎臟切片的 CD5 染色：間質浸潤的小淋巴球普遍呈膜狀弱至中度棕色著色，少數細胞染色較強（可能為背景 T 細胞）；與 PAX5 陽性的同一片浸潤重疊，代表 B 細胞共同表現 CD5，支持 CLL/SLL。
features: Diffuse membranous CD5 staining throughout the dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate
Weak to moderate staining in most cells, with scattered more intensely positive cells likely representing admixed T cells
Same distribution as the PAX5-positive infiltrate
Tubular epithelium and uninvolved parenchyma negative
describe_en: CD5 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse membranous staining of the dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate, generally weak to moderate in intensity, with scattered more strongly staining cells that likely represent admixed T cells. The distribution mirrors the PAX5-positive infiltrate, indicating aberrant CD5 expression on the neoplastic B cells. Tubules and adjacent parenchyma are negative. Together with PAX5, the findings support renal involvement by CLL/SLL; CD23 and LEF1 positivity with cyclin D1 negativity would further exclude mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: A reactive infiltrate would be CD5-positive but PAX5-negative, whereas here the CD5 staining coincides with the PAX5-positive B-cell sheet.
Mantle cell lymphoma is CD5-positive B-cell lymphoma distinguished by cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity and CD23 negativity.
It is composed of large cells with a high Ki-67 index, unlike the small monotonous lymphocytes here.
